findings: Quiz and results headings and cards remain readable and correctly spaced in both themes and mobile/desktop.

Element-only mobile quiz screenshot aligns the section bottom with the viewport and lets the fixed preview theme switcher overlap part of Continue. Normal scrolling moves Continue fully clear; all four corner hit tests and center hit test target the button, and clicking advances to mood in both modes. All eight mobile full flows already used successful native pointer clicks.
Axe incomplete items are image-backed footer contrast, dark choice gradients, and the menu glyph; inspected visual states remain readable. No axe violations.
Price comparison test was corrected to ignore layout whitespace between current and compare-at prices. All values remain identical to the actual rendered hidden native card bank.
